candidate_targets: man born and fallen into the world
contraindications: not a matter of hexing or lies
original_extraction.evidence_text:
Because there are clean flowers where I am going

---

There is no wind, there is no spit, there is no garbage, there is no
dust

---

There is no whirlwind, there is no weakness in the air

---

That is the work of my saints, that is the work of my saintesses

---

There is no complaint, there is no evil, there is no disgust, there is no
anger

---

It is not a matter of hexing anyone, it is not a matter of lies

---

It is a matter of life and well-being, of lifting up, of restoring

---

You are a man of business, a man of recompense, a man born and
fallen into the world, a man of cacao now, you are a man of
money, a man with a green staff, a staff of clarity, a respectable
man, an admirable man
generation_rules: affirmations of absence of negativity and presence of positive qualities
pause_rules: pauses indicated by '---' separating thematic sections
original_extraction.psychological_function: removal of negative emotions such as complaint, evil, disgust, anger; fostering clarity and respectability
repetition_rules: repeated negations of negative elements (no wind, no spit, no garbage, etc.)
original_extraction.therapeutic_function: lifting up, restoring, promoting life and well-being
voice_rules: declarative statements emphasizing absence of negative elements and presence of positive attributes
